entities.title: zazzle-git sources
entities.summary: The zazzle-git library, flat, and the three binaries in bin/ that call it: routing `zazzle git`, the commit flow, and the modeless message editor with its terminal, keys, rendering and git access.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole tool. router.rs decides what `zazzle git ARGS` asks for; commit.rs runs `zazzle git commit` with files.rs (marks and the git steps they become); message.rs runs `zazzle git message FILE`; editor.rs holds the editor state and what each key does, over buffer.rs (text, cursor, undo), find.rs, rebase.rs (todo-list commands), kind.rs (file kinds), tap.rs (double and triple arrow taps) and clipboard.rs; keys.rs decodes terminal bytes, render.rs draws a frame, term.rs owns /dev/tty; git.rs runs git and other commands. bin/ holds three four-line entry points.
boundaries: Every external program (git and the clipboard commands) is started through git.rs: captured with a timeout, attached to the terminal, or by replacing the process.

The editor's logic (editor.rs, render.rs, keys.rs) is pure: it takes key events with a time and returns frames, so editor_tests.rs and render_tests.rs drive it without a terminal; term.rs alone touches /dev/tty, raw mode and signals.
The binaries contain no logic of their own: each calls router::main, commit::main or message::main with the program's arguments.
